IGUI_TheZims_AboutBody: The Zims is the base. On its own it draws nothing in the world: what it brings is the frame every expansion plugs into - the drawing library, the theme, the 3D portrait and this window.|#How to use|Pick an expansion in the menu on the left. Each one tells you what it does, whether you have it, and gives you a switch to turn it on or off without touching the mod list or restarting.|Cards shown in solid blue are still being built. They are there so you can see what is coming; there is nothing to open inside them yet.|#One family, one look|Every piece is its own mod, updated on its own. The base keeps them looking like one thing: same colours, same rounded shapes, one window and one key.|#Controller|Controller players were part of the plan. The pie menu navigates by position on the stick - up and down walk a column, left and right cross sides - with A to confirm and B to go back.|#Compatibility|Tested alongside the NeatUI family with no conflicts. Nothing here replaces game systems: The Zims draws, it does not rewrite. If you hit a conflict with any mod, please report it - silent breakage is the one thing that cannot be fixed.|#What is coming|Animations on the pieces that open and close. Zim Panel, the status HUD with the 3D portrait, need bars, moodles and body condition. Zim Bath, a real bath in a bathtub. And more after those.
IGUI_TheZims_DlcActions: Replaces the loose vanilla progress bar with one anchored under your character, showing what you are actually doing. Its settings live in this window.
IGUI_TheZims_DlcBalloons: A thought balloon floats over your survivor's head showing what bothers them most: hunger, thirst, pain, panic and more. Uses the game's own moodle icons. Works on its own, no setup needed.
IGUI_TheZims_DlcBath: Take a real bath in a bathtub: your survivor gets in, washes, and comes out calmer. Hot water and soap make it count for more.
IGUI_TheZims_DlcBuildingHint: It shows up here once it is ready
IGUI_TheZims_DlcBuildingLabel: This DLC is still being built
IGUI_TheZims_DlcPanel: The Sims-style status panel: 3D portrait, need bars, moodles and body condition in one place. In development - coming soon.
IGUI_TheZims_DlcPie: The Sims-style pie menu. Replaces the right-click list with a wheel of rounded buttons around your survivor's 3D head. Options from other mods appear in the wheel automatically. Adjust how it looks and behaves below.
IGUI_TheZims_DlcRestart: Subscribe on Steam, then restart the game and enable it in the mod list
IGUI_TheZims_OptHead: Show your head in the middle
